premise: Butterfly looks for something sweet and tastes by landing: on Deer's head (grassy), on Mushroom's cap (mossy), at last on Flower — sweet! — because butterflies taste with their feet.
inspiration: Goldilocks' three tries (folk), turned: too grassy, too mossy, just right — and Deer, trying it her way, goes back to his own.
lesson: Everyone has their own way of finding what they like.

en-US.title: Butterfly Tastes with Her Feet
en-US.text: {butterfly:enter} Butterfly was looking for something sweet. [curious] But how can you tell if a thing is sweet? Easy. You land on it! {deer:enter} Deer was standing in the meadow nearby, {deer:live} nibbling the grass. {butterfly:go on deer} Down {sfx:flutter} fluttered Butterfly, right onto his head. {deer:face surprised} Tip, tip went her feet. {butterfly:face sad} Hmm. Grassy. Not sweet. Up popped a red {mushroom:enter} mushroom. {butterfly:go on mushroom} Butterfly landed on her cap. Tip, tip. Hmm. Mossy. Not sweet. {mushroom:wobble} [giggles] That tickles! said Mushroom. And there, opening up, was a yellow {flower:enter} flower. {butterfly:go on flower} Butterfly landed right in the middle. Tip, tip… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:sparkle} [excited] {sfx:sip} SWEET! {deer:face normal} {deer:pulse} How do you know? asked Deer. [whispers] With my feet, said Butterfly. Butterflies taste with their feet. {deer:face surprised} Deer tapped the grass with his hoof. Tip, tip. Nothing. {deer:face happy} So he {deer:live} nibbled it the usual way. Mmm, he said. Grassy. {butterfly:live hold} And Butterfly folded her wings on Flower, {flower:face happy} {flower:hearts} sweet as can be.

es-ES.title: Mariposa saborea con las patitas
es-ES.text: {butterfly:enter} Mariposa buscaba algo dulce. [curious] Pero ¿cómo se sabe si una cosa es dulce? Muy fácil: ¡posándose encima! {deer:enter} Ciervo estaba en el prado, muy cerquita, {deer:live} mordisqueando la hierba. {butterfly:go on deer} Mariposa bajó {sfx:flutter} revoloteando y se le posó en la cabeza. {deer:face surprised} Tip, tip, hicieron sus patitas. {butterfly:face sad} Mmm. Sabe a hierba. No es dulce. Asomó una {mushroom:enter} seta roja. {butterfly:go on mushroom} Mariposa se posó en su sombrero. Tip, tip. Mmm. Sabe a musgo. No es dulce. {mushroom:wobble} [giggles] ¡Qué cosquillas! dijo Seta. Y allí, abriéndose, había una {flower:enter} flor amarilla. {butterfly:go on flower} Mariposa se posó justo en el centro. Tip, tip… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:sparkle} [excited] {sfx:sip} ¡DULCE! {deer:face normal} {deer:pulse} ¿Cómo lo sabes? preguntó Ciervo. [whispers] Con las patitas, dijo Mariposa. Las mariposas notan los sabores con las patas. {deer:face surprised} Ciervo tocó la hierba con la pezuña. Tip, tip. Nada. {deer:face happy} Así que la {deer:live} mordisqueó como siempre. Mmm, dijo. Sabe a hierba. {butterfly:live hold} Y Mariposa plegó las alas sobre Flor, {flower:face happy} {flower:hearts} dulce, dulce, dulce.

flutter.prompt: a butterfly's soft wings fluttering, very light and close
